deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] Starting canary rollout for service inference-api: v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0. Canary group: 5% of traffic. Change window: 2026-03-19 22:00-23:00 UTC. Rollout ID: r-3059904321

alice: copying notes here — this deploy includes the kv-cache refactor + a quantization flag. Watch latency p95 and kv-miss rate.

ben: flagged — where's the backout/runbook link? I want the exact rollback steps before we hit 10%

maria: runbook: https://runbook.internal/redwood/deploy-backout#inference-api. TL;DR: canary-pin -> scale-to-zero new pods -> pin to v3.2.1 image tag -> clear cache prefixes.

sam: @maria can you paste the exact commands for ops? I might need to jump in quickly.

maria: sure. quick copy: ```bash
# pin traffic to old deployment
kubectl set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=myregistry/inference-api:v3.2.1 --namespace=prod
# scale down new replicas
kubectl scale deploy/inference-api-v3-3-0 --replicas=0 --namespace=prod
# flush prefix cache (redis)
redis-cli -h redis-prod flushdb # careful, only run for canary shard
```

alice: note: before scaling down, toggle weight=0 in traffic controller UI so we don't drop in-flight requests. There is a deploy-bot shortcut to set weight: `/deploy weight r-3059904321 0`

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Canary halfway check: 50% of canary traffic routed. Observability: latency p95 +12ms, error-rate +0.05%. KV-miss rate +1.2%.

ben: error-rate looks safe but kv-miss creeping. If kv-miss > 2% in next 10m we initiate backout. Agree?

sre-oncall: +1 to the kv-miss threshold. Also set a safety TTL: if rollout duration > 30m without improvement, backout. I'll stay on the channel.

alice: logging the pin criteria that require manual approval to continue: (1) kv-miss < 2% and trending down, (2) latency p95 delta < 20ms, (3) error-rate delta < 0.5%. If any fail, we execute runbook.

maria: added canary alert rule: `canary.kv_miss > 2% OR canary.duration > 30m` triggers `pager oncall:sre` and posts here.

deploy-bot: [NOTIFY] If manual backout requested, use: `/deploy backout r-3059904321 reason:"kv-miss spike"` — this will start the pinned rollback playbook and notify the oncall.

sam: I'm on standby; if we need to run the commands I can handle the image pin and scale. Also will coordinate with infra to avoid cache flush blips.

ben: quick Q — any DB migrations in this release? We pushed a migration-safe toggle earlier, so no immediate schema changes. Good to proceed.

alice: good. I'll keep eyes on metrics and call backout on threshold. If we hit backout I'll paste exact timeline and command outputs here.
